title: WorkshopOrder as the portal pulls it
description: PROPOSAL workshop-order: the payload of a pulled WorkshopOrder row. It is the till's own 0.1.85 entity (every member required, unchanged) with the values the portal's BikeBook connector fills: source connector, provider bikebook, status open or cancelled, the till-side members empty. rowVersion = externalVersion = the portal's version of the order (rising by one on every change).
